text.content:
A pocket of real calm off the Middens, defensible and dry, with the ash of old campfires in one corner suggesting other travelers have sheltered here before. Nailed to a post is a slate board, carefully lettered, headed "NUZZLE STANDINGS - OFFICIAL - DO NOT ERASE (Grull)."

GM Notes

Breather: Safe to rest here. No wandering threat is keyed to this room.

Subquest - The Nuzzle Board: A goblin scribe (Nibbin, if you want a name) maintains this board with obsessive seriousness and will not shut up about it. It's a live snapshot of the same politics seen in Room 1 - names rise and fall based on llama attention alone. Nibbin will trade a favor (a shortcut hint, a warning about a specific room's ward or hazard) for help improving a name's standing, which in practice just means luring a llama somewhere convenient. Entirely optional, entirely silly, genuinely useful if the party bothers.
